rubric.role_summary: Senior engineer leading the design and development of 12–25 kg thrust-class jet engines for interceptor drones, from concept through flight-ready hardware, including turbine design, additive manufacturing, airframe integration, and testing.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior engineer leading the design and development of 12–25 kg thrust-class jet engines for interceptor drones, from concept through flight-ready hardware, including turbine design, additive manufacturing, airframe integration, and testing.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 8+ years of jet engine or gas turbine design experience.
- Understanding of jet engine architecture, including the compressor, combustor, turbine, fuel system, controls, and their interactions.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience integrating propulsion into flying wings or similar unconventional airframes.
- Experience specifically with UAV or drone propulsion rather than manned aviation.
- Familiarity with low-cost manufacturing strategies for defense or dual-use hardware.
- Prior startup or skunkworks experience.
- Minimum 8 years of jet engine or gas turbine design experience, with a proven track record of designing and delivering engine models rather than only components.
- Hands-on experience with small jet engines in the 12–25 kg thrust class.
- Experience designing turbine or engine components for metal additive manufacturing, linked with practical knowledge of metal 3D printing processes and constraints.
- Experience integrating propulsion systems into airframes.
- Knowledge of design requirements for extreme operating environments, including temperature extremes, precipitation, and icing.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Toulouse area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
